## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Oct 7, 2026 - Oct 17, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _NoCrapApps_, Oct 14, 2026, 1/5: "Update:Nope. Still broken. Latest update logs you out everytime immediately. Seriously stupid. Whatever needs to be done to fix this it needs to be done immediately. No excuses, fix it."
            2. _iObsidian_, Oct 9, 2026, 1/5: "The latest Planet Fitness app redesign is a perfect example of fixing something that wasn’t broken. Instead of prioritizing the membership card—the app’s most essential function for members entering the gym—the developers have placed workouts and workout tracking front and center. Why? The primary purpose of this app, at least for many members, is simple: open the app, access your membership barcode, and get into the gym. We shouldn’t have to navigate through workout plans or log the type of workout I’m doing just to find my entry pass. At the very least, users should be able to customize the home screen and choose which features appear first. Put the membership card front and center, and let members who want workout tracking access those features on their own terms. They are prioritizing secondary features over basic functionality. Make the membership card the default home screen again, or give users the option to decide for themselves."
